title: Biovigilance Component | NHSN | CDC
content: Biovigilance Component Hemovigilance Module (HV) Print Minus Related Pages Activating the Biovigilance Component enrolls your facility into the Hemovigilance Module. Reporting to the module allows for systematic monitoring of adverse reactions related to blood transfusions. Facilities Reporting in the Biovigilance Component Children’s Hospitals Critical Access Hospitals General Hospitals (including Acute, Trauma, and Teaching) Long-term Acute Care Hospitals Oncology Hospitals Orthopedic Hospitals Surgical Hospitals Veteran’s Hospitals Women’s Hospitals Women and Children’s Hospitals New Users Biovigilance Component Training BV Cheat Sheet [PDF – 429 KB] Hemovigilance Module Access relevant training, protocol, data collection forms, and supporting materials for the module.
